en: Lamentations 3

p.src: 1  I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

en: I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
u.src: 1  I am the man who has seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.

p.src: 2  He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.

en: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.
u.src: 2  He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.

p.src: 3  Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long.

en: Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long.
u.src: 3  Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long.

p.src: 4  He has made my flesh and my skin old. He has broken my bones.

en: He has made my flesh and my skin old. He has broken my bones.
u.src: 4  He has made my flesh and my skin old. He has broken my bones.

p.src: 5  He has built against me, and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.

en: He has built against me, and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.
u.src: 5  He has built against me, and surrounded me with bitterness and hardship.

p.src: 6  He has made me dwell in dark places, as those who have been long dead.

ja: はるか昔に死んだ者のように、
en: He has made me dwell in dark places, as those who have been long dead.
u.src: 6  He has made me dwell in dark places, as those who have been long dead.

p.src: 7  He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. He has made my chain heavy.

en: He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. He has made my chain heavy.
u.src: 7  He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. He has made my chain heavy.

p.src: 8  Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.

en: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.
u.src: 8  Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.

p.src: 9  He has walled up my ways with cut stone. He has made my paths crooked.

en: He has walled up my ways with cut stone. He has made my paths crooked.
u.src: 9  He has walled up my ways with cut stone. He has made my paths crooked.

p.src: 10  He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in hiding.

en: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in hiding.
u.src: 10  He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in hiding.

p.src: 11  He has turned away my path, and pulled me in pieces. He has made me desolate.

ja: から引き離し、 私を
en: He has turned away my path, and pulled me in pieces. He has made me desolate.
u.src: 11  He has turned away my path, and pulled me in pieces. He has made me desolate.

p.src: 12  He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

en: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
u.src: 12  He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.

p.src: 13  He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.

ja: を、 私の体の奥深く
en: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.
u.src: 13  He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.

p.src: 14  I have become a derision to all my people, and their song all day long.

ja: 私は自分の民すべてのあざけりとなり、
en: I have become a derision to all my people, and their song all day long.
u.src: 14  I have become a derision to all my people, and their song all day long.

p.src: 15  He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.

ja: たし、 よもぎで飽き足らせた。
en: He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.
u.src: 15  He has filled me with bitterness. He has stuffed me with wormwood.

p.src: 16  He has also broken my teeth with gravel. He has covered me with ashes.

en: He has also broken my teeth with gravel. He has covered me with ashes.
u.src: 16  He has also broken my teeth with gravel. He has covered me with ashes.

p.src: 17  You have removed my soul far away from peace. I forgot prosperity.

en: You have removed my soul far away from peace. I forgot prosperity.
u.src: 17  You have removed my soul far away from peace. I forgot prosperity.

p.src: 18  I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from the LORD.”

en: I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from the LORD.”
u.src: 18  I said, “My strength has perished, along with my expectation from the LORD.”

p.src: 19  Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.

ja: しみと悲惨、 よもぎと
en: Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.
u.src: 19  Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.

p.src: 20  My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.

en: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.
u.src: 20  My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.

p.src: 21  This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.

en: This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.
u.src: 21  This I recall to my mind; therefore I have hope.

p.src: 22  It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.

ja: のあわれみは終わらない。
en: It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.
u.src: 22  It is because of the LORD’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail.

p.src: 23  They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.

en: They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
u.src: 23  They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.

p.src: 24  “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”

en: “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”
u.src: 24  “The LORD is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”

p.src: 25  The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.

en: The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
u.src: 25  The LORD is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.

p.src: 26  It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.

en: It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
u.src: 26  It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.

p.src: 27  It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

en: It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
u.src: 27  It is good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.

p.src: 28  Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.

ja: わせたのだから、 一人で座り、
en: Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.
u.src: 28  Let him sit alone and keep silence, because he has laid it on him.

p.src: 29  Let him put his mouth in the dust, if it is so that there may be hope.

ja: みがあるかもしれない。
en: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if it is so that there may be hope.
u.src: 29  Let him put his mouth in the dust, if it is so that there may be hope.

p.src: 30  Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.

ja: を差し出し、 そしりを
en: Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.
u.src: 30  Let him give his cheek to him who strikes him. Let him be filled full of reproach.

p.src: 31  For the Lord will not cast off forever.

ja: を 退けることはない。
en: For the Lord will not cast off forever.
u.src: 31  For the Lord will not cast off forever.

p.src: 32  For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

ja: しみによってあわれむ。
en: For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
u.src: 32  For though he causes grief, yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

p.src: 33  For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.

ja: は進んで人を苦しめず、
en: For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.
u.src: 33  For he does not afflict willingly, nor grieve the children of men.

p.src: 34  To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,

en: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,
u.src: 34  To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,

p.src: 35  to turn away the right of a man before the face of the Most High,

en: to turn away the right of a man before the face of the Most High,
u.src: 35  to turn away the right of a man before the face of the Most High,

p.src: 36  to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.

ja: えを不当に退けることを、
en: to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.
u.src: 36  to subvert a man in his cause, the Lord doesn’t approve.

p.src: 37  Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?

ja: じないのに、 だれが
って、それを実現できるか。
en: Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?
u.src: 37  Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?

p.src: 38  Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?

en: Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?
u.src: 38  Doesn’t evil and good come out of the mouth of the Most High?

p.src: 39  Why should a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

en: Why should a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
u.src: 39  Why should a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?

p.src: 40  Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.

en: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
u.src: 40  Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.

p.src: 41  Let’s lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.

en: Let’s lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.
u.src: 41  Let’s lift up our heart with our hands to God in the heavens.

ja: 3:41 「神」と訳されたヘブル語は「אֱלֹהִים」（エロヒム）である。
en: 3:41 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “אֱלֹהִ֑ים” (Elohim).

p.src: 42  “We have transgressed and have rebelled. You have not pardoned.

ja: き、反逆した。 あなたは私たちを
en: “We have transgressed and have rebelled. You have not pardoned.
u.src: 42  “We have transgressed and have rebelled. You have not pardoned.

p.src: 43  “You have covered us with anger and pursued us. You have killed. You have not pitied.

ja: して、 あわれまなかった。
en: “You have covered us with anger and pursued us. You have killed. You have not pitied.
u.src: 43  “You have covered us with anger and pursued us. You have killed. You have not pitied.

p.src: 44  You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.

ja: けられないようにした。
en: You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.
u.src: 44  You have covered yourself with a cloud, so that no prayer can pass through.

p.src: 45  You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the middle of the peoples.

ja: で、 くずとごみとした。
en: You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the middle of the peoples.
u.src: 45  You have made us an off-scouring and refuse in the middle of the peoples.

p.src: 46  “All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.

en: “All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.
u.src: 46  “All our enemies have opened their mouth wide against us.

p.src: 47  Terror and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.”

en: Terror and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.”
u.src: 47  Terror and the pit have come on us, devastation and destruction.”

p.src: 48  My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

en: My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
u.src: 48  My eye runs down with streams of water, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

p.src: 49  My eye pours down and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,

ja: け、 絶えることがない。 休むこともない。
en: My eye pours down and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,
u.src: 49  My eye pours down and doesn’t cease, without any intermission,

p.src: 50  until the LORD looks down, and sees from heaven.

en: until the LORD looks down, and sees from heaven.
u.src: 50  until the LORD looks down, and sees from heaven.

p.src: 51  My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.

en: My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.
u.src: 51  My eye affects my soul, because of all the daughters of my city.

p.src: 52  They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.

en: They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.
u.src: 52  They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.

p.src: 53  They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.

en: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.
u.src: 53  They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and have cast a stone on me.

p.src: 54  Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”

en: Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”
u.src: 54  Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”

p.src: 55  I called on your name, LORD, out of the lowest dungeon.

en: I called on your name, LORD, out of the lowest dungeon.
u.src: 55  I called on your name, LORD, out of the lowest dungeon.

p.src: 56  You heard my voice: “Don’t hide your ear from my sighing, and my cry.”

en: You heard my voice: “Don’t hide your ear from my sighing, and my cry.”
u.src: 56  You heard my voice: “Don’t hide your ear from my sighing, and my cry.”

p.src: 57  You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, “Don’t be afraid.”

en: You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, “Don’t be afraid.”
u.src: 57  You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, “Don’t be afraid.”

p.src: 58  Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul. You have redeemed my life.

en: Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul. You have redeemed my life.
u.src: 58  Lord, you have pleaded the causes of my soul. You have redeemed my life.

p.src: 59  LORD, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.

en: LORD, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.
u.src: 59  LORD, you have seen my wrong. Judge my cause.

p.src: 60  You have seen all their vengeance and all their plans against me.

ja: と、 私に対するすべての計画をご
en: You have seen all their vengeance and all their plans against me.
u.src: 60  You have seen all their vengeance and all their plans against me.

p.src: 61  You have heard their reproach, LORD, and all their plans against me,

en: You have heard their reproach, LORD, and all their plans against me,
u.src: 61  You have heard their reproach, LORD, and all their plans against me,

p.src: 62  the lips of those that rose up against me, and their plots against me all day long.

en: the lips of those that rose up against me, and their plots against me all day long.
u.src: 62  the lips of those that rose up against me, and their plots against me all day long.

p.src: 63  You see their sitting down and their rising up. I am their song.

ja: もご覧になっている。 私は彼らの歌になっている。
en: You see their sitting down and their rising up. I am their song.
u.src: 63  You see their sitting down and their rising up. I am their song.

p.src: 64  You will pay them back, LORD, according to the work of their hands.

en: You will pay them back, LORD, according to the work of their hands.
u.src: 64  You will pay them back, LORD, according to the work of their hands.

p.src: 65  You will give them hardness of heart, your curse to them.

ja: らにかたくなな心を与え、 あなたの
en: You will give them hardness of heart, your curse to them.
u.src: 65  You will give them hardness of heart, your curse to them.

p.src: 66  You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of the LORD.

en: You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of the LORD.
u.src: 66  You will pursue them in anger, and destroy them from under the heavens of the LORD.
